size.value: Described as 'standard passport size' by the Embassy of Afghanistan in Islamabad (not independently restated in mm/cm on this page; consistent with the 4×4.5cm ordinary-passport figure found on the same embassy's passport page)

validity.value: Must be recent; two identical, matching photographs required, affixed to the visa application form

ears_visibility.value: Photo must be taken straight-on ('directly off the face') so that both ears are shown clearly.

ears.en: Photo must be taken straight-on so that both ears are shown clearly.
ears.ko: 얼굴을 정면으로 향하여 양쪽 귀가 뚜렷이 보이도록 촬영해야 한다.
ears.ja: 顔を正面に向け、両耳がはっきり見えるように撮影すること。

cross_verification.note_en: Background (white) matches the current DB value exactly. Size is only described qualitatively ('standard passport size') by the source, not a restated numeric figure, so it is reported as verified-but-qualitative rather than compared numerically against the DB's 4×4.5cm.
